llc.formation_notes: Statutory SOS fee $100 (W. Va. Code § 59-1-2); foreign LLC certificate of authority $150.

annual_report.name: Annual Report
annual_report.due: between January 1 and July 1 of each year following the year of formation

sources.title: W. Va. Code § 59-1-2 Fees
sources.quote: (C) Articles of organization of limited liability company, $100;

sources.title: W. Va. Code § 31B-1-108
sources.quote: Every limited liability company shall pay the annual report fee of $25 ... or the biennial report fee of $50

sources.title: W. Va. Code § 31B-2-211 Annual and Biennial Report
sources.quote: Subsequent annual reports must be delivered to the Secretary of State between January 1 and July 1 of the ensuing calendar years.

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Elective PTET (Form EPT-100) at the top individual marginal rate (4.58% for 2026); annual irrevocable election by the return due date incl. extensions; not available to disregarded entities. Enacted by SB 151 (2025), retroactive to tax year 2022.

sources.title: W. Va. Code § 11-21-3a
sources.quote: A tax equal to the top marginal rate on individuals under this article on the West Virginia taxable income of an electing pass-through entity

personal_exemption.notes: $2,000 deduction per exemption (dependents included). Same bracket table for single, MFJ and head of household; MFS uses halved brackets.

sources.title: W. Va. Code § 11-21-4j Rate of tax, taxable years beginning on and after January 1, 2026 (SB 392, 2026)
W. Va. Code § 11-21-16 Personal exemptions
sources.quote: with respect to any taxable year beginning on or after January 1, 1987, said exemption shall be $2,000.

estimated_tax.required_if: WV AGI other than withheld wages expected to exceed $400 plus personal exemptions (statute); third parties cite owing $600+
estimated_tax.notes: Form IT-140ES. 2026 form not located on tax.wv.gov.

unemployment_2026.notes: Statutory base $9,500; new employers 2.7% for first 36 months (out-of-state construction firms 7.5%). SB 1053 (2026) adds an automation/administration fee from July 1, 2026, offset by a rate reduction (not verified on an official page).

local_taxes.name: Municipal business and occupation (B&O) tax on gross income
local_taxes.applies: cities may levy B&O on gross income of businesses operating within city limits; services capped at 1% of gross income (W. Va. Code § 8-13-5 via § 11-13-2k)
local_taxes.quote: or in excess of one percent of gross income under §11-13-2k of this code

local_taxes.name: City B&O tax, Service/All Other Businesses
local_taxes.applies: gross income from services rendered in the city or directed from a city location

notable: Income tax cut again for 2026 (SB 392): top rate 4.58% (was 4.82% in 2025) (https://code.wvlegislature.gov/11-21-4j/)
No standard deduction; only a $2,000 personal exemption (https://code.wvlegislature.gov/11-21-16/)
No LLC franchise tax; $25 annual report, and from July 1, 2026 an LLC with 5 timely years can elect a $50 biennial report (https://code.wvlegislature.gov/31B-2-211/)
Many cities (e.g., Charleston 1% on services) charge a municipal B&O tax on gross receipts (https://code.wvlegislature.gov/8-13-5/)
Elective PTET available at the top individual rate (https://code.wvlegislature.gov/11-21-3A/)
uncertain: Annual report late penalty not verified.
Charleston B&O rate taken from a 2022 city FAQ; current rate not reconfirmed; Charleston also has a $2/week city service fee (not verified).
2026 IT-140ES not found on tax.wv.gov; the $600 threshold is from third parties, statute uses $400 + exemptions.
SB 1053 UI fee details not verified on an official page.
